Just as we converged on a single agent in Pinecone, we wanted one “gateway” that safely connects AI agents to the tools and systems that power our company.

  > It’s powered by Model Context Protocol (MCP), which has quickly become the standard way for exposing tools to AI agents. Traversal is a Software Development company. Traversal employs 72 people (+9400.0% YoY). Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Sweden. Has $48M in total funding, with 4 prior funding rounds.

## About

Traversal is an AI platform for site reliability engineering that troubleshoots, remediates, and prevents production incidents — even in the largest, most complex systems.

Two core AI breakthroughs make this possible: a continuously-updated Production World Model™ that maps your system in real time, and a Causal Search Engine™ that identifies root cause across 10+ hops, from apps to services to infrastructure to networking, reducing investigation time from hours to minutes.

Deployed in enterprises such as American Express, Pepsi, CapitalOne, DigitalOcean, and Kraken, Traversal improves system resilience — reducing MTTR and reclaiming engineering hours lost to troubleshooting.

Founded by a team of AI researchers and engineers from MIT, Columbia, Berkeley, and Cornell, and backed by Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins.

Elorian AI is a Software Development company. Elorian AI employs 18 people, founded in 2025. Headquartered in Palo Alto, California, United States. Has $105M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

## About

We are an early-stage AI lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former Google Brain & DeepMind researchers, including Andrew Dai, who was previously a leader on Gemini. Our team consists of world-class scientists and engineers. Summary:
Teleport is a fast-growing software development company (founded 2015, HQ in Oakland) offering a platform for secure, on-demand access to infrastructure built on cryptographic identity and zero trust. The company emphasizes identity-led security, access governance, and unified policy control across infrastructure, with a focus on protecting against identity provider compromise.

Key hiring and growth signals relevant to your query:
- Headcount and growth: 225 employees (201-500 range) with strong growth metrics (YoY +38.3%, MoM +5.7%); expanding rapidly in 2025–2026.
- Hiring activity: 16 active job openings, including senior and specialized engineering roles (Senior Backend Engineer, Senior Web Design Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Platform Security/Scalability, Machine & Workload Identity), plus a Product & Privacy Counsel and Field Engineering roles for EMEA.
- Geographical expansion: Workforce distributed across 11 countries; significant US presence (US ~50%), with roles in UK and Ireland reflecting international hiring for engineering and platform security.
- Recent talent movements: Ongoing onboarding of new hires (e.g., July 2026 cohort of 12 new hires across engineering and GTM), signaling scaling of both technical and go-to-market capabilities.

What this suggests for your query:
- Teleport is actively scaling its team in 2025–2026, hiring across multiple engineering specializations (backend, platform security, scalability, web design) and Go-to-MTM roles.
- They are increasing headcount internationally (EMEA focus with Ireland/UK roles) to support growth.
- The company’s focus areas align with rapid scaling of both engineering and sales/go-to-market functions to support expanded infrastructure protections and product reach.

# Omnistrate (Omnistrate, Inc.)

Omnistrate is a Software Development company. Omnistrate is a control-plane as-a-service that transforms your docker image into a multi-cloud SaaS service. Omnistrate employs 22 people (+9.1% YoY, +2 people), founded in 2023. Headquartered in Redwood City, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across India, United States, and Canada. Has $1.3M in total funding, with 1 prior funding round.

## About

Omnistrate is building the foundation for how modern software companies bring products to market across increasingly complex customer environments. We serve AI companies, and software vendors (ISVs) that need to meet enterprise requirements across cloud, customer-controlled, and sovereign environments.

We founded the company to help software companies scale faster by removing the burden of building bespoke delivery and operations logic for every new cloud or customer environment. Our leadership team includes the original architects behind foundational systems like the AWS control plane, AWS Aurora, and Confluent Cloud—bringing decades of expertise to help you reach more customers

Summary:
Omnistrate is a Redwood City-based software development company offering a control-plane as-a-service that converts Docker images into multi-cloud SaaS. Founded in 2023, it has 22 employees (distributed across India, the US, and Canada) and raised $1.3M in total funding. The leadership includes veterans from AWS, Aurora, and Confluent Cloud, with YC backing. The company is actively growing, with a strong hiring signal in 2025–2026 across multiple roles (engineering, product, GTM, sales) and 5 open positions at present, including Software Engineer, Platform Engineer in the US, SDR (India), AE, and a Community Evangelist. Omnistrate emphasizes rapid scaling of software teams and operations, aiming to help software companies scale faster by removing delivery/ops burdens for new clouds and customers. Notable growth metrics: monthly growth ~4.3%, YoY growth ~9.1%, and active hiring surging (recent postings trends). If your goal is a company actively scaling headcount across engineering and sales with multiple open roles in 2025–2026, Omnistrate matches those criteria.

properties.description:
Omnistrate is building the foundation for how modern software companies bring products to market across increasingly complex customer environments. We serve AI companies, and software vendors (ISVs) that need to meet enterprise requirements across cloud, customer-controlled, and sovereign environments.

We founded the company to help software companies scale faster by removing the burden of building bespoke delivery and operations logic for every new cloud or customer environment. Our leadership team includes the original architects behind foundational systems like the AWS control plane, AWS Aurora, and Confluent Cloud—bringing decades of expertise to help you reach more customers 

Backed by Y Combinator and based in the San Francisco Bay Area, Omnistrate is powered by a distributed team across the US and India.

For more information, please visit omnistrate.com and to join our team, visit omnistrate.com/careers

# NO BS Asia

NO BS Asia is a Technology, Information and Internet company. NO BS works with founders and sales leaders to execute sales motions that actually convert in Asia. They work in them — running outbound, holding sales conversations, and building P&L. NO BS Asia employs 3 people, founded in 2024. Headquartered in Singapore. Its workforce is distributed across Singapore and India.

## About

NO BS Asia works with early and growth-stage tech companies expanding across Asia.

Most engagements start at a similar point:

- The product is solid, not proven
- Home market is figured out
- Asia features heavily in decks, but not in the numbers

We focus on execution rather than theory.

In practice, that means:
- clarifying who to sell to and why
- building a targeted pipeline
- running a disciplined sales motion
- closing early customers and making it repeatable

We are not a strategy consulting firm.
We work best when outcomes matter more than presentations.

If you are looking to turn Asian demand into pipeline and P&L impact, get in touch.

The provided 2025–2026 examples show emphasis on senior marketing hires and related growth signals, with Honch noting which roles are being filled and how those moves could influence decisions (budgets, agency reviews, technology, sponsorships). Tannous Capital is a Business Consulting and Services company. Tannous Capital employs 3 people. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Pakistan, and Estonia.

## About

Tannous Capital helps founder-led B2B SaaS companies generate qualified sales meetings through a fully done-for-you outbound system.

We work best with SaaS teams that have traction, sell $5k+ offers, and need a more predictable pipeline without hiring an internal SDR team.

Many companies reach a stage where referrals and inbound are no longer consistent enough to hit growth goals. That’s where we help.

Our process includes:
• ICP research and targeting
• Messaging and positioning
• Manual LinkedIn outbound
• Follow-up systems
• Calendar booking with qualified prospects

Recent results:
• $1.5M+ pipeline opportunities generated through outbound
• 40+ monthly meetings produced using our internal system

If you're a B2B SaaS company looking for more qualified sales conversations, send us a message.

Most B2B SaaS companies don't have a GTM problem. They have a systems problem.

The pipeline is inconsistent. The SDR isn't ramping. Outbound works some months and disappears the next. And hiring a VP of Demand Gen feels too early or too expensive.
That's exactly why we started OutPro.

Most B2B SaaS & AI companies have a great product. But an empty pipeline.

Not because their product isn't good enough. But because outbound sales demands time, expertise and consistency that founders and small teams simply don't have.

That's why Pure Sales was founded.

We are the dedicated sales partner for B2B SaaS & AI companies that want to grow without the risk of an expensive in-house sales team. No fixed salaries, no months of ramp-up, no hassle. Just qualified meetings with the right decision-makers.

How? With a proven approach:
→ We build a hitlist of your ideal customers (ICP)
→ Our senior BDRs call C-level directly, in their language, in their market
→ You only pay for meetings that actually take place. 100% No Cure, No Pay.

Live within 14 days. Trusted by 60+ leading SaaS & AI companies.

Are you a B2B SaaS or AI founder ready to fill your pipeline without the risk? Let's talk.

# Agentible

Agentible is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Agentible.dev is a cold outreach intelligence platform for B2B sales and marketing teams. It offers a platform for finding enriched, verified leads, launching ai-personalized cold email sequences, and tracking every open, reply, and booked meeting in real-time. The platform is built for founders, agencies, and b2b teams that need qualified pipeline. Agentible employs 2 people, founded in 2026. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its workforce is distributed across Kenya and United States.

## About

Agentible is an AI-powered revenue operations company that helps B2B organizations convert pipeline into predictable, qualified revenue.

We eliminate the inefficiencies between outreach, qualification, and closed deals so sales teams spend time selling, not filtering noise.

The Problem

Most B2B pipelines are full but ineffective.
Calendars fill with prospects who lack budget, authority, or real buying intent, draining SDR capacity, slowing account executives, and reducing overall ROI.

This “pipeline bloat” creates activity without outcomes and stalls growth.

Our Approach: Precision-Qualified Revenue

Agentible replaces volume-driven prospecting with precision-engineered opportunity creation.

We combine advanced AI automation with structured human qualification to ensure that every conversation entering your pipeline is commercially viable and decision-ready.

Core capabilities include:

Advanced Qualification Frameworks
Decision-maker validation across budget, authority, need, and timing before a meeting is scheduled.

AI-Driven Intent Detection & Outreach
Identification of real buying signals across the market, enabling engagement at the exact moment demand emerges.

Seamless Revenue Workflow Integration
Plug-and-play alignment with your CRM, SDR, and AE processes eliminating manual research, follow-up gaps, and post-demo ghosting.

Why Agentible

Revenue growth is not constrained by lead volume it is constrained by qualified access to real buyers.

Agentible delivers a predictable, scalable revenue engine that transforms cold outreach into pre-vetted, sales-ready opportunities allowing your team to focus exclusively on closing.

Your pipeline shouldn’t just be full.

Summary for: Agentible (agentible.dev)

- What it is: A private AI-powered RevOps platform and cold outreach intelligence solution designed for B2B sales and marketing teams. Built to convert pipeline into qualified, sales-ready opportunities with AI-assisted prospecting, verified lead enrichment, and automated, personalized email sequences.
- Core value proposition: Replace volume-focused outreach with precision-driven opportunity creation. Combines AI automation with structured human qualification to ensure every meeting is decision-ready (budget, authority, need, timing) and to reduce post-demo gaps and “pipeline bloat.”
- How it helps founder-led, small teams / no SDRs:
  - Enables founders or small teams to generate qualified meetings without a full SDR squad.
  - Automates AI-driven cold outreach and follow-ups while validating decision-makers before scheduling.
  - Integrates with existing CRM/SDR/AE workflows to minimize manual research and ensure high-quality engagement.
  - Aims to deliver a predictable, scalable revenue engine by pre-vetting opportunities and accelerating close-focused activity.
- Target use cases: B2B sales and marketing teams seeking higher meeting-to-opportunity conversion, reduced follow-up friction, and better utilization of limited sales capacity.
- Geography and team: San Francisco-based, distributed across Kenya and the United States; founded in 2026 with a small team (2 employees listed).
- What makes it different: Focus on “precision-engineered” opportunity creation over volume, with decision-maker validation and real buying signal detection to engage buyers at demand emergence.

If you’re a founder-led B2B company without a dedicated SDR team and need more qualified meetings in 2025–2026, Agentible positions itself as a plug-and-play RevOps and AI outbound that aims to deliver pre-vetted, sales-ready opportunities and reduce time spent on filtering noise.
